const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Parse nowcoder html and fetch douban group search",
  command: `cd "D:\\GitHub\\My-second-brain\\50-知识\\AI工具\\_scripts"
$nc = Get-Content "_b_nc_discuss.html" -Raw -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "=== nowcoder has __NEXT_DATA__? ==="
$nc.Contains("__NEXT_DATA__")
$nc.Contains("讨论")
Write-Host "=== sample of body text ==="
$t = [regex]::Replace($nc,'<script[\\s\\S]*?</script>','')
$t = [regex]::Replace($t,'<style[\\s\\S]*?</style>','')
$t = [regex]::Replace($t,'<[^>]+>',' ')
$t = [regex]::Replace($t,'\\s+',' ')
$t.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(1500,$t.Length))
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== douban group search ==="
curl.exe -sL -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" --max-time 20 --compressed -o "_b_db_search_fuye.html" -w "DBSEARCH %{http_code} %{size_download}" "https://www.douban.com/group/search?cat=1019&q=%E5%89%AF%E4%B8%9A"
`,
  timeoutMs: 90000
});
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text + "\n---ERR---\n" + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));
